COMPUTER NETWORKS
Engineering Course Syllabus

UNIT - I Introduction to Computer Networks

Network models and topologies used in modern communication systems.
OSI reference model and TCP/IP protocol suite overview.
Physical layer concepts including transmission media and encoding schemes.

UNIT - II Data Link Layer and Medium Access Control

Framing techniques, error detection, and error correction methods.
Multiple access protocols including CSMA/CD and token passing.
Ethernet standards and wireless LAN fundamentals.

UNIT - III Network Layer and Addressing

Routing algorithms including distance vector and link state approaches.
IPv4 addressing, subnetting, and introduction to IPv6 essentials.
Network layer design issues and congestion control overview.

UNIT - IV Transport Layer Protocols

TCP and UDP protocol operation and comparison.
Flow control, reliability mechanisms, and socket programming basics.
Transport Layer connection establishment and teardown procedures.

UNIT - V Application Layer Services

HTTP, DNS, email, and file transfer protocol fundamentals.
Application Layer security themes and common network threats.
Integration of Transport Layer and Application Layer concepts for end-to-end communication.
